props.name: checked
props.description:
Whether the checkbox is checked (controlled). Accepts `trueValue` or `true` for checked,
`falseValue` or `false` for unchecked, and `'indeterminate'` for the mixed state. Leave it
`undefined` for uncontrolled state; update it from `onCheckedChange`.

props.name: checkedIcon
props.description: Icon to show when checked.

props.name: class
props.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: classes
props.description: Family slot class defaults for this instance.

props.name: defaultChecked
props.description:
Initial checked state when uncontrolled; also the state restored when the surrounding
native form is reset. Accepts `true`, `false`, or `'indeterminate'`.

props.name: description
props.description: Description rendered under the label and linked to the control with `aria-describedby`.

props.name: disabled
props.description:
Whether the control is disabled: it cannot be interacted with and sets `aria-disabled`.
When omitted, the control inherits `disabled` from the surrounding `Field`; an explicit
`false` overrides the `Field`.

props.name: falseValue
props.description:
Value that represents the unchecked state, passed to `onCheckedChange` and stored as the
value of a bound `Field`.

props.name: form
props.description:
The id of a `<form>` the hidden input belongs to, instead of the closest
ancestor form.

props.name: id
props.description:
The ID of the control's main focusable element, which a surrounding `Field` label points to
with `for`. A unique ID is generated when omitted. The control's related parts (hidden
input, label, description) derive their IDs from it, so keep it unique on the page.

props.name: indeterminateIcon
props.description: Icon to show when indeterminate.

props.name: indicatorPosition
props.description: Placement of the selection indicator relative to the label.

props.name: inputRef
props.description:
Ref to the hidden native `<input type="checkbox">` that carries the form value. The visible
control is a separate `<button role="checkbox">`.

props.name: label
props.description:
Label rendered beside the control and linked to it. With `variant="card"` the whole card
toggles the checkbox when clicked.

props.name: name
props.description:
The name of the control, used for native form submission. When omitted, the control uses
the name of its form binding or a string `name` set on the surrounding `Field`.

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.description:
Called when the user toggles the checkbox, with `trueValue` (now checked) or `falseValue`
(now unchecked). Toggling from `'indeterminate'` checks it. Not called while `disabled` or
`readOnly`, nor when `checked` changes from outside.

props.name: onPointerDown
props.description:
Handler for `pointerdown` on the checkbox control button. Call `event.preventDefault()` to
skip the built-in handling, which keeps focus on the hidden input when it is already
focused.

props.name: readOnly
props.description:
Whether the control is read-only: the value is visible and focusable but cannot be changed,
and `aria-readonly` is set. When omitted, the control inherits `readOnly` from the
surrounding `Field`.

props.name: required
props.description:
Whether the control is required, which sets `aria-required` (and the native `required`
attribute where the control renders a native input). When omitted, the control inherits
`required` from the surrounding `Field`.

props.name: size
props.description: Visual size of the component.

props.name: style
props.description: Style applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: styles
props.description: Family slot style defaults for this instance.

props.name: trueValue
props.description:
Value that represents the checked state: it is passed to `onCheckedChange`, stored as the
value of a bound `Field`, and compared with `checked`. A string or number `trueValue` is
also the native value submitted when `value` is not set.
examples:
import { Checkbox } from 'moraine'

<Checkbox
  trueValue="yes"
  falseValue="no"
  label="Accept the terms"
  onCheckedChange={(value) => console.log(value)} // 'yes' or 'no'
/>

props.name: value
props.description:
Native value submitted when the checkbox is checked. Defaults to a string or number
`trueValue`, otherwise `'on'`.

props.name: variant
props.description:
Layout of the checkbox. `list` is a plain row of control, label, and description, where only
the control and label toggle. `card` wraps them in a bordered, padded card that toggles when
clicked anywhere outside nested interactive elements. When omitted, it renders like `list`.
